title: Size independence of consistency index for pairwise comparison matrices in analytic hierarchy process
summary: Pairwise comparisons are fundamental in the analytic hierarchy process. Various consistency indices have been proposed to assess inconsistencies in these comparisons. Since Saaty first proposed his consistency index, the assessment of the degree of consistency in pairwise comparison matrices has remained an open and hot topic in the study of the analytic hierarchy process. The consistency indices CI and CR proposed by Saaty are defined using the principal eigenvalue of the pairwise comparison matrix.
